info.title: RangeWatch API
info.description: Species-keyed MLOps service for MaxEnt species distribution models: incremental GBIF/iNaturalist ingestion, conditional retraining, model lineage, map-layer descriptors (titiler / pg_tileserv) and automated bulletins.

get.description:
The calling user and role, so the UI can offer only permitted actions (the API
enforces them regardless).
Resolve free text to canonical GBIF backbone taxon keys, enriched with iNat metadata.
The registry, optionally only the species of one species list (U9).

post.description: Enqueue the incremental-fetch / conditional-retrain pipeline (full run if new).
Project the current model onto registered climate scenarios (no retraining).
Refit the current model on the independent cross-check climate stack (e.g. CHELSA).
Project the current model at high resolution (e.g. 30″) inside a region.

put.description:
Save a user-reviewed polygon (analyst). Confirming it — which unlocks (re)training —
is an expert review step and needs the curator role.

get.description: Paginated occurrence list for table views (map layers use pg_tileserv vector tiles).

put.description:
Update the severity weights/priors and re-weight the current model's components
(no retraining; returns null if no model exists yet).

Train and project a regional model inside `bbox` (optionally at a registered high
resolution), or remove the region (bbox null) to return to the global model. Changing it
flags a retrain; the current model stays published until then.

post.description: Names are matched against the GBIF backbone (unmatched ones are kept, unresolved).

put.description: Replace the list's name, description, source and species.

post.description:
One batch job running the species pipeline for every resolved species of the list
(new species stop at the native-range review, as in a single run).
B1: refit with order / class / phylum target groups (and matched source + years).

B9: estimate the observer bias jointly from every registered species of this
species' target group (used by SDM_ALGORITHM=ppm with SDM_PPM_BIAS=shared).

get.description: The shared bias estimate of the species' target group, if one was made.
Reference datasets with each model version's independent evaluation on them.

post.description:
Upload a survey as an evaluation dataset (default) or as training data. Columns are
detected unless named; rows of other species are dropped when the file has a species
column. A training upload flags the species for retraining.

delete.description:
Remove an uploaded dataset and its records. Scores already stored with model versions
stay in their lineage; removing a training upload flags the species for retraining. GBIF
absences are managed by the pipeline and cannot be removed.

post.description: Re-run the independence check and score every model version on every dataset.

get.description: Annotation history, newest first (optionally for one record).

post.description:
Annotate one GBIF / iNaturalist record (curator). A correction is a newer annotation;
nothing is ever overwritten. Flags a retrain when the species has a model.

get.description: RSS 2.0 feed of alerts (all species, or one).
Subscriptions covering one species (its own + all-species), or all.
All model versions, newest first, with full reproducibility metadata.
U13: plain-language summary, the confidence label and caveats first.
Live job list for a species (or all jobs): replaces client polling while connected.

200.description: text/event-stream of `jobs` events; each `data:` line is a JSON array of JobOut (newest first, same as GET /jobs), sent on connect and on change

get.description: Latest virtual-species bias benchmark: which bias correction recovers a known niche.
